newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: DORBYL BRAKE UNIT TO ENTER U.S. MARKET.
newsitem.headline: DORBYL BRAKE UNIT TO ENTER U.S. MARKET.

text.p: Dorbyl Ltd said on Thursday its brake block unit, Metpro, had recently opened an office in New York in a bid to secure a share of the lucrative U.S. market.
"Metpro America Inc are looking to secure a 10 percent share of the $70 million America market," Dorbyl said in a statement.

Metpro, a unit of Dorbyl Transport Products, is currently involved in new product development in conjunction with potential U.S. customers. This is expected to lead to worldwide co-operation in the supply and delivery of brake blocks.
Dorbyl said the Association of American Railways was expected to approve Metpro's friction material early in 1997 after which the U.S. market would be open to sales from South Africa.
